subtitle: Contract & Malpractice Defense
description:
MDEsq is the premier executive medicolegal intelligence and rights defense radar engineered specifically for licensed physicians, surgeons, and healthcare executives.

Key Capabilities:
• Hospital Contract Redlining: Instant audit of restrictive covenants (RCW 49.62), malpractice tail obligations, uncompensated emergency call, and indemnity clauses with verbatim negotiation scripts.
• Malpractice Precedent Matcher: Multi-jurisdiction caselaw finder (WA, OR, CA, NY) matching clinical complications against landmark standard of care precedents with defensive charting directives.
• Fair Market Value (FMV) & Stark Law Calculator: National compensation benchmarks across 13 medical/surgical subspecialties with commercial reasonableness verification.
• Sham Peer Review Diagnostic Index: 10-Factor bad-faith retaliation analyzer and 30-day HCQIA summary suspension timeline.
• Deposition Masterclass: 8 Cardinal Deposition Rules and Reptile Theory cross-examination counter-scripts.
• Zero-Knowledge Privacy: 100% on-device PHI scrubbing.
